summary:
w180's fix commit 4f1d4641 (the same change as the reported 1a2b008e) rewrites step 4 of skills/formulating-features/SKILL.md.
It gives pytest-bdd's test naming, finds the node id with --collect-only | grep, and treats a selection of zero or several tests as no verdict (fix the selection or stop, r22). Review 6's F1 is fixed: a passing scenario is no longer removed for not being collected (r4).
No test or features/ change. tools check is clean; tools size prints nothing.
F1 (Minor, observation): the stated rule drops '_', which pytest-bdd keeps (16 titles, e.g. ..._v_t1). Harmless, since the skill says to collect and grep and not to trust the derived name.
F2 (Minor, drop): the commit subject says 'take no collection as a verdict', the opposite of the text.
